critical_distinction.kinematic_representation: How authorized rotations and topology are encoded/resolved.
critical_distinction.causal_motion_law: Why and when ARCANA changes rotations, rates, boundaries, or plate identities.

master_geometry.regional_refinement: Must derive from authorized vector boundaries and retain source support/provenance.

input_contract: time-valid plate feature geometries and stable IDs
ARCANA-authorized finite rotations or angular velocities with reference frame and validity
topology/boundary state and authorized event transitions
seed/event state only where an authorized stochastic rule uses it
authority, support, uncertainty and provenance envelopes
output_contract: resolved topological plates/boundaries where input topology supports resolution
derived angular/linear velocities only where mathematically supported by supplied kinematics
input/output identity and deterministic run metadata
adapter_rules: Solver resolves supplied state; it MUST NOT select motion laws, event times, rift locations, collision outcomes, subduction polarity, or uplift laws.
pyGPlates-specific classes are adapter-internal and are not canonical R6 schema.
A replacement solver must satisfy the same normalized inputs, outputs, validity, determinism and diagnostic tests.
No raster upsampling may create vector boundary evidence.
No interpolation across rotation discontinuities or feature lifetime boundaries.

Within a declared continuous finite-rotation segment, geometry at a query time may be evaluated by exact spherical rotation composition; this is kinematic evaluation, not categorical-state interpolation.

lineage_operations.split: ARCANA event defines event ID, parent, children, time, geometry, pre/post state and new boundaries; solver resolves geometry only.
lineage_operations.merge_or_termination: ARCANA event explicitly terminates/relates IDs while preserving historical queryability.
lineage_operations.boundary_change: Requires explicit ARCANA event and valid pre/post topology.

restart_requirements: deterministic seed substream state where consumed
validation_requirements: partition gap/overlap tests where full coverage is expected
current_blockers: no master vector/topological t0 plate geometry bound
no causal motion law or numeric rotations
